messages:
sara_support: Hi team — ClearPath is seeing p95 token-latency spikes and intermittent 429s on their Dedicated pool (eu-west-1). Started ~10:12 UTC after autoscaler added slices. They report degraded throughput and higher costs. repro steps: hitting /v1/llm/generate with batch size=8 and seq=2048.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler event: scaled up pool clearpath-eu-dedicated from 6 -> 8 slices at 2024-11-06T10:11:43Z :arrow_up_small:

sara_support: attaching quick span of nvidia-smi and tail of runtime logs (snippet):
```
[2024-11-06T10:12:05Z] node-83 nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu --format=csv
GPU-0, 98 %, 72 %, 78 C
GPU-1, 15 %, 12 %, 52 C
...
runtime: token-gen p95 1.4s -> 3.8s, backend 429 count +12
```

tim_oncall: looks like asymmetric SM saturation on some GPUs (one slice hot). Any MIG mapping for node-83? can we get `runtimectl inspect node-83 --slices` output?

jia_infra: pulled slice map. node-83 has 4 MIG slices: [1g.5gb, 2g.10gb, 1g.5gb, 2g.10gb]. ClearPath's tenant pinned to slices 0 and 2 (both small), new tenant popped on slice 1 and drives SM/PCIe contention. Also noticed the autoscaler colocated new slices on same host due to binpack policy.

luis_sre: interesting — fractional workload (long-seq conversational) will thrash KV cache; co-located larger slice sees high SM utilization; tiny slices suffer from scheduling jitter and preemption -> 429s. Recommend short-term: migrate ClearPath to an isolation profile (no cotenant) or temporarily set pool policy to spread instead of binpack.

sara_support: customer is sensitive to migration downtime. What's quickest mitigation? Can we route ClearPath traffic to spare isolates in same region or bump to burst capacity?

tim_oncall: quick options:
- Set routing policy for tenant -> isolate (moves their slices to empty nodes) [zero-downtime but needs capacity]
- Evict offending tenant slice with `infractl evict-slice --node node-83 --slice 1g.5gb` then let autoscaler rebalance
- Apply temporary qos throttle on noisy tenant

jia_infra: I can carve out 2 empty host slots in eu-west-1 and start a drained migration. ETA ~12 mins. I'll also flag autoscaler config: binpack threshold currently 0.9, suggest lowering to 0.7 for dedicated pools with mixed seq workloads.

sara_support: thanks. I'll tell ClearPath we're doing a migration and to expect improvement in ~15–20m. collecting additional artifacts: please add `nvprof` traces and runtime perf counters if perf doesn't improve.

luis_sre: follow-up: create an alert rule to detect asymmetric per-GPU util difference >60% for >2m and auto-isolate tenant when triggered. I'll open an ops ticket.

sara_support: noted. customer confirmed decreased 429s after migration started. will monitor and close if stable. :thumbsup:
